Names.md:33:Names keep the case you give them, and an exactly matching name always wins when a [[Link|link]] is resolved. Link.md:35:2. **Name lookup**: if no file exists at the literal path, SilverBullet looks for files matching the ref _anywhere_ in the space, comparing case-insensitively. A bare name (no `/`) matches any file carrying that name. A ref containing `/` matches any file whose path _ends_ in it (on folder boundaries, so `[[api/Auth]]` matches `docs/api/Auth` but not `webapi/Auth`). Candidates spelled with the exact same case are preferred. If exactly one remains, that is the target.
